svg.text: Top view. Letters are columns, numbers are rows. Match pins by the labels printed on your boards.
No resistors needed. The firmware limits it.
ESP32: rows 1–15, VIN side in column i,
so column j stays free. USB hangs off row 1.
DRV8833: rows 20–25, across the middle gap.
IN pins on top, IN1 at row 20.
